value: The game's FeedAction raises max HP by 3 (4 upgraded) and heals as much when its hit kills a non-minion, non-half-dead target (live run 16); the engine does it via content condition TargetDied (Feed row TargetDied -> GainMaxHp), a winning kill gaining before combat-end relics. The gauntlet keeps max HP fixed between fights, so simulated runs drop the gain.
